name: Linear
description: Create, update, and read Linear issues.

methods.whenToUse: Use the provider-hosted connection for the quickest setup.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Linear for issues and projects. Paperclip registers its own OAuth client with Linear MCP; no developer-console setup is needed.
methods.label: Sign in with Linear

methods.whenToUse: Use a Linear API key when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a Linear API key with the permissions needed for the actions you intend to allow. A key restricted to Read is supported for read-only use; workspace and role access still apply.
methods.label: Use an API key

credentialFields.label: Linear API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Choose intended permissions and teams when creating the personal API key. Read-only is supported with Read permission only.

warnings: Linear’s standard MCP endpoint exposes read and write tools; review the discovered catalog and Paperclip action policies.
